title: SendGrid rejects scheduled emails with 'Scheduling more than 72 hours in advance is forbidden'
symptoms: 400 Scheduling more than 72 hours in advance is forbidden
Reminder emails for next week fail while tomorrow's succeed
send_at in milliseconds rejected or scheduled far in the future
cause: send_at must be a Unix timestamp in seconds no more than 72 hours ahead. Date.now() values are milliseconds.
fix: Keep your own queue for anything beyond 72 hours and hand it to SendGrid inside the window, with send_at in seconds.
apply: send_at: Math.floor(sendDate.getTime() / 1000)  // only when sendDate - now <= 72h
affected: SendGrid v3 Mail Send send_at, as of 2026-10
